description: Return one Loa hospital or provider entity profile by exact slug or entity_pages.id. Includes profile-field provenance to distinguish source-file fields from Loa-reviewed overrides. Includes correction_url for listing/price corrections and optional affiliation verification in one form; do not tell users to file a separate claim for both. claim_url is for affiliation-only requests. Neither form requires an existing account; dashboard access requires verification. Offer these links only when requested. Use loa_link.label verbatim for the returned destination; a website action leads to the hospital/provider website, not a Loa listing.

entity_type.description: Optional disambiguation when slug_or_id is a slug.

slug_or_id.description: Exact Loa entity slug or entity_pages.id from search_entities.

name: get_entity_profile

loa_link.description: Share this returned URL with its exact label. A website action redirects to the provider website; only a profile action opens a Loa listing. Do not infer the destination from the loacare.com domain.

label.description: Use this exact label as the link text; it identifies the destination.

source_url.description: Supporting source link. A CMS Hospital Price Transparency policy page is not the hospital source file; do not attribute hospital-published prices to CMS.

anyOf.description: Offer only when the user asks to correct, add prices to, or claim this listing.

claim_url.description: Request affiliation verification only. For corrections plus verification, use correction_url instead. Submitting does not grant dashboard access.

correction_url.description: Suggest listing or price changes and optionally request affiliation verification in the same form. No separate claim or existing account is required.

title: Entity Profile
